description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Foreign Exchange Act, No. 12 of 2017 order under section 8 (Reserved)
categorisation: This gazette content is an amendment to a foreign exchange regulation (Foreign Exchange Act, No. 12 of 2017) under Section 8 of that Act. It modifies currency retention limits and establishes new compliance requirements for foreign currency holdings. While it mentions Minister Ranil Wickremesinghe, it does so only in his capacity as the authority issuing the regulatory order, not as a personnel appointment or with detailed portfolio responsibilities. The core content is purely regulatory/legal in nature, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette.
